topic: Effect of propeller rotation on aircraft and methods used to counteract it.
syllabus_extract: Effect of propeller rotation on aircraft and methods used to counteract it.
specific_objectives: 11.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to describe the various types of propellers, principles of operation and pitch change mechanisms.

practical: Demonstration of P-factor using a spinning propeller model; Safety: Ensure model is secured; Supervision: Instructor monitors student observation.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of a propeller?
List three types of propellers based on pitch change mechanism.

development.content:

summary_questions: Explain how P-factor affects aircraft yaw during high angles of attack.
Describe the specific control inputs required to counteract torque reaction.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how propeller rotation effects influence takeoff and landing performance, referencing the next lesson plan on engine power management.
